fields.name: add

fields.name: reset

types.name: NativeInputAdapter

fields.name: consume

when the pointer moves over them, so cache validation ignores them.

fields.name: cursor

fields.doc: Copies resolved typography onto this node's concrete layout payload.

fields.name: onPointerDownOutside

fields.name: setWindowDecoration
fields.doc: Assigns this node's bounds to the native window-chrome hit-test map.

fields.name: onPaint
fields.doc:
Adds a custom paint callback. The callback draws in node-local coordinates
with (0, 0) at the node's top-left corner; native layout owns placement,
transforms, and ancestor clipping. A cache key opts the callback into
retained display-list reuse and must change whenever its local output can
change for reasons other than size or computed style.

fields.name: addDecoration
fields.doc:
Adds a decoration. Supplying a cache key opts it into retained display
list reuse; the key must include any external inputs read by the
decoration that are not represented by computed style or geometry.

types.name: ResolvedTextStyle
types.doc: Concrete typography snapshot emitted onto a text-capable render node.

fields.name: merge
fields.doc: Applies sparse local changes without mutating either input style.

fields.name: withTextColor

types.name: RetainedView

fields.name: label

fields.doc: Reads serialize() output; null when the text names no key or an unknown modifier.

fields.name: isModifierKey
fields.doc: Shift, Control, Alt and Super on either side: pressed alone they are not a shortcut.

fields.name: keyName

types.name: State

fields.name: updateQuietly
fields.doc:

types.name: StateStore
types.doc: Haxe-owned per-widget state retained while views are rebuilt.

fields.name: resolveWidgetId

fields.name: rememberPath

fields.name: prunePaths

fields.name: beginFrame

fields.name: usageMarker

fields.name: retain

fields.name: touch

fields.name: endFrame

fields.name: diagnosticCounts

fields.name: onUnmount
fields.doc: Registers a resource cleanup callback and enables per-frame liveness cleanup.

fields.name: dispose
fields.doc: Releases registered widget resources and clears the store.

fields.name: hitTestMetrics

types.name: FrameGcScheduler
types.doc:
Keeps garbage collections out of frames. HashLink collects stop-the-world whenever allocation since
the last collection passes a fraction of the heap, which lands the pause inside whichever frame
happened to allocate. While a frame renders, automatic collection is off; the collection runs
afterwards, immediately when allocation pressure has passed `forceAtPressure` times the normal
trigger (so continuous animation cannot grow the heap without bound), or when the host goes idle.
With HL_GC_INCREMENTAL=1, frame boundaries advance marking in best-effort slices;
the allowance is shared with explicit steps during rendering. Idle and emergency
collections still finish synchronously.

fields.name: IdlePressure
fields.doc: Pressure is bytes allocated since the last collection over the collector's own trigger size.

fields.name: fromEnvironment
fields.doc: `MATERIA_FRAME_GC=0` turns frame-boundary collection off so it can be compared against the default.

fields.name: endFrame

fields.name: idle

fields.name: tick
fields.signature: (now:Float, pump:NativeKitEvents, window:WindowHandle, checkpoint:(String) -> Void, before:(Float) -> Void, after:(Float) -> Void):Bool
fields.doc: Dispatch one due event; the host drains overdue input before requesting the next frame.

types.doc:
How the settings dialog organizes a registry.

A setting's first two path segments name its category in the tree
("interface/editor"); a two-segment path files under its first segment.
Segments between the category and the name group rows into sections
("fonts" in "interface/editor/fonts/main_font_size"). Settings without a
section come first, under the category's own label.

Defining the same path again with the same type and default returns the
first definition, so modules can share a setting; any other redefinition is
a programming error.

types.name: SettingsStore
types.doc:
Current setting values over the registry's defaults, saved as JSON.

Only values that differ from their default are kept and saved, so changing
a default in code reaches everyone who never touched that setting. Saved
values whose setting is not defined in this build are kept and written back
unchanged, because another build or a module that loads later may define
them. A saved value that no longer fits its setting falls back to the
default. Every change saves at once unless it happens inside batch().

The same file also keeps application state that is not a setting, such as
recently opened files: JSON-compatible values under a key, never shown in
the settings dialog and never validated.

fields.name: file
fields.doc: Where values are saved; null keeps them in memory only.

fields.name: revision
fields.doc: Increases on every change, for views that cache what they show.

fields.name: lastError
fields.doc: Why the last load or save failed, or null when it worked.

fields.name: getString
fields.doc: The text of a Text setting or the option key of an Enum setting.

fields.name: set

fields.name: resetUnder
fields.doc: Resets every setting at or below the prefix.

fields.name: onChanged
fields.doc:

below the prefix; an empty prefix hears every change. Returns a function
that removes the listener.

fields.name: setState
fields.doc: Saves JSON-compatible application state under the key; null removes it. Listeners are not told.

fields.name: batch
fields.doc: Runs the work and saves once at the end instead of after every change.

fields.doc:
Writes every changed value, plus saved values this build does not
define, through a temporary file so a crash never leaves half a file.
Returns false (and sets lastError) when writing fails; settings are a
convenience, so failing to save must not disturb the caller.

fields.name: unknownPaths
fields.doc: Paths of every saved value this build does not define.

fields.doc: Updates the container style without discarding editor drafts or section state.

fields.name: setSectionExpanded
fields.doc: Changes a section's expansion state for the next submitted frame.

fields.name: contentRevision
fields.doc: Revision of transient editor state that must invalidate a retained panel.

fields.name: errorFor
fields.doc: Current validation/transaction error for a descriptor, if any.

fields.name: applyValue
fields.doc: Applies through the row editor assigned to the descriptor's section.

types.name: ScrollAxis
types.doc: Axes whose content may move inside a ScrollView viewport.

types.name: ScrollBinding
types.doc: Mount-owned binding; replacing or unmounting a viewport retires its animation.

types.name: ScrollController
types.doc: Haxe-owned scroll offsets and resolved viewport/content metrics.

fields.name: jumpTo
fields.doc: Sets an absolute offset, clamped to the latest resolved content metrics.

fields.name: configureAnimation
fields.doc: Enables time-based exponential movement; jumpTo always remains immediate.

fields.name: scrollBy
fields.doc: Queues logical-pixel movement. Reversals discard the previous pending direction.

types.name: ScrollView
types.doc: Clipped Haxe scroll container translated from its persistent controller offset.

fields.name: showScrollbar
fields.doc: Shows an interactive overlay scrollbar when vertical content overflows.

fields.name: fillViewport
fields.doc: Expand content to fill a short viewport while retaining intrinsic scroll overflow.

fields.name: contentExtentProvider
fields.doc: Optional intrinsic content dimensions for clipped or virtualized document widgets.

fields.name: scrollbarVisibility
fields.doc: Null inherits the application environment policy.

fields.name: scrollbarOverlayHost
fields.doc: Optional non-scrolling ancestor with the same vertical extent.

types.name: ScrollbarVisibility
types.doc: Shared scrollbar visibility policy; Auto reveals on pane hover or scroll activity.

types.name: ScrollbarVisibilityController
types.doc: Mount-owned scrollbar visibility, independent of scroll geometry and paint.

fields.name: hovered
fields.doc: Track hover controls its stronger styling separately from pane hover.

fields.name: reveal
fields.doc: Reveals from the current opacity; repeated activity never restarts the fade.

types.name: SettingsPanel
types.doc:
Editor-settings browser: a filter and Advanced switch over a category tree,
with the selected category's settings in a sectioned inspector.

Keep one panel for as long as the dialog is open; it holds the filter,
selection and inspector state between frames. Every state change calls
onChanged so the host can rebuild.

fields.name: selectedCategory
fields.doc: The category shown on the right, or null when nothing matches.

fields.name: select
fields.doc: Selects a category, or the first category under a tree group such as "interface".

fields.name: categories
fields.doc: Categories the tree lists for the current filter, in order.

fields.name: currentInspector
fields.doc: The inspector for the selected category; rebuilt only when the category, filter or Advanced switch changes.

types.name: ShortcutGroup
types.doc: Command IDs listed under one heading.

types.name: ShortcutsPanel
types.doc:
Lists every command with its shortcuts and lets the user rebind them.

Commands are grouped by the first part of their ID ("editor.save" under
Editor). Clicking a shortcut records the next key chord: Escape cancels,
and modifier keys alone keep waiting. A chord another command in the same
scope used is moved to this one, and the panel says so.

fields.name: recordingId
fields.doc: The command waiting for a key chord, or null.

fields.name: notice
fields.doc: What the last change did besides the obvious, such as taking a chord from another command.

fields.name: shortcutWidth
fields.doc: Width of each row's shortcut button.

fields.name: record
fields.doc: Starts recording a chord for the command; recording it again stops.

fields.name: press
fields.doc:
Handles a key press while recording. Returns true when the press was
used: assigned, cancelled with Escape, or a modifier held for a chord.

fields.name: shortcutText
fields.doc: "Ctrl+S, Ctrl+Shift+S", or "None".

fields.name: groups
fields.doc: Visible command IDs by group, groups in order of their first command.

types.name: SidebarHost
types.doc: One content-owned tab strip; inactive providers never build.

fields.name: headerActions
fields.doc: Optional fixed header actions for the active destination.

fields.name: headerActionsVisible
fields.doc: Evaluate against the built pane; hidden actions retain their layout space.

types.name: SidebarMode
types.doc: A stable mode with a provider evaluated only while its page is mounted.

types.name: SidebarModeOptions
types.doc: Registration metadata; sizing belongs to the sidebar container.

types.name: SidebarModel
types.doc: View-independent sidebar registration and validated persistent presentation.

fields.name: rememberWidth
fields.doc: Container width is shared by every destination. Resolution records it without a rebuild.

fields.name: restore
fields.doc: Parse atomically. Legacy layouts migrate using the saved active destination's width.

types.name: CodepointOffset
types.doc: Compatibility name for the editor core type.

types.name: DefaultTextStyle
types.doc: Applies sparse typography to a subtree while preserving outer inheritance.

types.name: EditTransaction
types.doc:
One atomic editor mutation.

All positions are absolute Unicode code-point offsets in the document. A
platform adapter must convert its native offset representation before
creating this value. A null replacement text is treated as an empty string.

fields.name: selectionAffinity
fields.doc: Caret affinity for the resulting selection focus.

fields.name: compositionAttributes
fields.doc: Optional generic clause metadata for the resulting composition.

fields.name: historyKind
fields.doc: History grouping policy for this transaction.

fields.name: replacedText
fields.doc: Text removed by an applied transaction; null for an unannotated request.

types.name: GraphemePosition
types.doc: Compatibility name for the editor core type.

types.name: MiddleEllipsisText
types.doc: Fits a single-line label with an ellipsis, preserving both ends by default or only the prefix.

types.name: SelectionDragController
types.doc: Keeps selection scrolling while a captured pointer remains near a viewport edge.

fields.name: configure
fields.signature: (scheduler:AnimationScheduler, editor:TextEditorState, geometry:() -> Null<ResolvedLayoutItem>, selectAt:(Float, Float) -> Void, scroll:(Float) -> Bool):Void

fields.name: layoutResolved
fields.doc: Scroll transforms are authoritative only after layout resolves.

types.name: Text
types.doc: Text view backed by the NativeUI/Skribidi text layout primitive.

types.name: TextArea
types.doc: Multiline text editor sharing the TextField IME and selection model.

fields.name: withDocument
fields.doc: Creates a multiline editor backed by a shared EditorKit document.

types.name: TextCompositionSpan
types.doc:
Generic metadata for one IME composition clause.

Ranges use absolute Unicode code-point offsets, like EditTransaction. The
flags describe semantic state only; themes choose how selected and target
clauses are painted.

types.name: TextDecoration
types.doc: Immutable decoration in absolute document codepoint coordinates.

fields.name: rectangles
fields.doc: Reuses shaped range geometry, merging adjacent grapheme rectangles.

fields.name: paint
fields.doc: Clips horizontal work to the viewport, including the wavy path's segment count.

types.name: TextDecorationKind
types.doc: Geometry decorations applied behind or above retained text.

types.name: TextEditIntent
types.doc: An editing operation that a controlled document owner may consume before widget mutation.

types.name: TextEditorAction
types.doc: Editor actions shared by widget input and application command surfaces.

types.name: TextEditorDiagnostics
types.doc: Frame-local text and IME state exposed by an active TextField.

fields.name: new
fields.signature: (key:String, label:String, focused:Bool, selectionStart:Int, selectionEnd:Int, caretOffset:Int, compositionStart:Int, compositionEnd:Int, compositionText:String, ?caretRect:Rect, platformSupported:Bool, platformActive:Bool):Void

types.name: TextEditorHistoryKind
types.doc: Source/coalescing policy attached to one edit transaction.

types.name: TextEditorLayout
types.doc: Retained layouts for bounded groups of paragraphs in one editor document.

fields.name: codeWordBoundaries
fields.doc: Explicit code editing policy, independent of wrapping and syntax highlighting.

fields.name: geometryRevision
fields.doc: Changes whenever edits or shaping constraints recompute paragraph geometry.

fields.name: colorRangeProvider
fields.doc:
Supplies sorted, disjoint absolute codepoint ranges for one visible chunk.
Ranges may extend beyond the requested chunk and are clipped to it.
The provider is queried at paint time, so text edits can refresh styles.

fields.name: update
fields.doc: Updates only paragraph resources whose text or shaping inputs changed.

fields.name: updateDocument
fields.doc: Updates retained paragraph layouts directly from the segmented document.

fields.name: setTextAfterEdit
fields.doc:
Updates the affected chunk window while preserving all other boundaries.
Chunks grow locally to the hard paragraph bound before being split.

fields.name: paragraphCaret
fields.doc: First visual caret of a logical paragraph, using retained shaping geometry.

fields.name: visualRows
fields.doc:
Resolved visual rows, including wrapped continuations and the final empty row.
Offsets are absolute codepoints; vertical bounds are in document coordinates.

fields.name: paragraphIndexAtY
fields.doc: Logical paragraph containing a vertical position in the shaped document.

fields.name: measureForConstraints
fields.doc: Measures this retained content against the constraints of a Custom node.

fields.name: paintWhitespace
fields.signature: (canvas:Canvas, mode:String, selections:Array<TextSelection>, color:Color, selectedColor:Color, minY:Float, maxY:Float, minX:Float, maxX:Float):Void
fields.doc: Whitespace is a paint-only decoration; source offsets and shaping stay unchanged.

fields.name: paint
fields.doc: Paints retained paragraphs intersecting the visible document range.

fields.name: paintDecorations
fields.doc: Paints one decoration layer using cached measured range geometry.

fields.name: wholeLineRects
fields.doc: Whole-line decoration geometry from indexed visual rows in the viewport.

fields.name: selectionRangeRects
fields.doc: Returns shaped grapheme rectangles paired with absolute document ranges.

types.name: TextEditorRangeGeometryCache
types.doc: Cached selection geometry for one active editor range and viewport.

fields.name: new
fields.signature: (start:Int, end:Int, startAffinity:Int, endAffinity:Int, minY:Float, maxY:Float, rectangles:Array<TextRangeRect>):Void

types.name: TextEditorState
types.doc: Persistent editable text, selection and IME composition state for one widget ID.

fields.name: scrollOffsetY
fields.doc: Vertical scroll offset in the editor's content coordinate space.

fields.name: tailFollowing
fields.doc: Read-only logs keep the newest text in view until the user scrolls away from the end.

fields.name: renderMeasurement
fields.doc: Measurement-only provider for widgets that place painting in separate layers.

fields.name: configurePresentation
fields.doc: Presentation callbacks may change without text or measurement changing.

fields.name: updateStyle
fields.doc: Updates inherited typography without replacing the retained editor state.

fields.name: insert
fields.doc: Inserts committed text over the current selection.

fields.name: replace
fields.doc: Replaces a code-point range and places a collapsed caret after the insertion.

fields.name: applyTransaction
fields.doc: Applies one replacement and its resulting selection and composition together.

fields.name: surroundingText
fields.doc: Returns surrounding text while keeping selection and composition in the window.

fields.name: applyTextEdit
fields.doc: Applies one transactional NativeKit composition/edit update.

fields.name: setAnchoredSelection
fields.doc: Imports an external anchored selection only when its logical value differs.

fields.name: placeCaret
fields.doc: Places a caret and optionally extends the existing anchored selection.

fields.name: moveCaret
fields.doc: Moves by grapheme; a non-extended move collapses an existing selection first.

fields.name: moveCaretByWord
fields.doc: Moves by Skribidi word boundaries; direction is -1 or +1.

fields.name: moveCaretByParagraph
fields.doc: Moves by paragraph for Control+Up/Down or macOS Option+Up/Down.

fields.name: moveCaretVertically
fields.doc: Moves to the nearest visual line while preserving the requested x column.

fields.name: moveCaretToLineBoundary
fields.doc: Moves to the start or end of the current visual line.

fields.name: configureTail
fields.doc: Enables or disables tail following; enabling it starts pinned to the end.

fields.name: setViewportHeight
fields.doc: Records the viewport height without moving the scroll position to reveal the caret.

fields.name: scrollBy
fields.doc: Scrolls the viewport by a wheel delta, without disturbing the selection.

fields.name: requestCaretReveal
fields.doc: Selection state and viewport movement are independent; layout only consumes explicit requests.

fields.name: ensureCaretVisible
fields.doc: Adjusts internal scrolling so the active caret or selection remains in the viewport.

fields.name: deleteWord
fields.doc: Deletes a selection or one shaped word as a single edit.

fields.name: hitTestSelectionDrag
fields.doc:
Dragging beyond the document selects its boundary, independent of horizontal position.
Inside the document, use the viewport-clamped Y so edge scrolling stays incremental.

fields.name: placeCaretAt
fields.doc: Places the caret from a shaping-engine hit while keeping its visual affinity.

fields.name: resetCaretBlink
fields.doc: Restarts the caret blink after keyboard, pointer, or text-edit activity.

fields.name: isCaretVisible
fields.doc: Returns whether the focused caret should be painted at the given UI time.

fields.name: nextCaretBlinkTime
fields.doc: Wall-clock deadline for the next caret visibility change.

fields.name: compositionRects
fields.doc: Returns the shaped rectangles used to paint the active IME preedit underline.

fields.name: compositionRangeRects
fields.doc: Returns active composition rectangles paired with absolute document ranges.

fields.name: selectWordAt
fields.doc: Selects the word under a pointer position using the shaped text engine's boundaries.

fields.name: selectLineAt
fields.doc: Selects the visual line under a pointer position.

fields.name: beginPointerSelection
fields.doc: Retains the original word/line so dragging extends whole semantic units.

fields.name: registerPointerClick
fields.doc: Returns 1 for a single click, 2 for a double click, and 3 for a triple click.

fields.name: completePointerClick
fields.doc: Arms a click for a possible double click only after a nearby pointer release.

fields.name: cancelPointerClickIfMoved
fields.doc: Cancels click recognition once movement exceeds the platform-independent slop.

fields.name: layoutText
fields.doc: Native text services interpret Haxeon's null representation of empty strings as empty UTF-8.

types.name: TextField
types.doc: Text editor composed from a Haxe box and NativeUI text primitive.

fields.name: renderWhitespace
fields.doc: Paint-only whitespace visibility: off, selection, or all.

fields.name: placeholder
fields.doc: Muted visual hint shown only while the editor is empty.

fields.name: ellipsizeWhenUnfocused
fields.doc: Show a trailing ellipsis while an overflowing single-line value is not being edited.

fields.name: colorRangeProvider
fields.doc: Sorted, disjoint absolute codepoint foreground ranges for a visible chunk.

fields.name: decorationProvider
fields.doc: Backgrounds and underlines in absolute document codepoint coordinates.

fields.name: presentationRevision
fields.doc: Increment when state captured by presentation providers changes.

fields.name: selectionProvider
fields.doc: Optional controlled selection, queried on rebuild after shared-document synchronization.

fields.name: onSelectionChange
fields.doc: Reports widget selection after edit callbacks have synchronized a caller-owned document.

fields.name: onEditorAction
fields.doc: Explicit navigation/edit request for owners that manage an outer viewport.

fields.name: additionalSelectionProvider
fields.doc: Additional owner-controlled selections; the primary stays in selectionProvider.

fields.name: onNavigationIntent
fields.doc: Handles navigation of all selections when additional carets are present.

fields.name: pageHeightProvider
fields.doc: Logical viewport height when an outer scroll container owns scrolling.

fields.name: historyManagedExternally
fields.doc: True when an application document owns undo/redo.

fields.name: onSelectionDragScroll
fields.doc: Optional external viewport scroll; delta uses application layout coordinates.

fields.name: selectionTextProvider
fields.doc: Optional aggregate selected text for clipboard copy/cut.

fields.name: onTextPointerDown
fields.doc: Optional pointer action at the text offset; true consumes normal selection handling.

fields.name: onTextPointerMove
fields.doc: Hit-tested pointer movement, independent of selection dragging.

fields.name: classes
fields.doc: Typed selector classes used by composite fields such as ComboBox.

fields.name: readOnly
fields.doc: Selectable and copyable but not editable; multiline fields also scroll with the wheel.

fields.name: followTail
fields.doc: With readOnly, keeps the newest text in view until the user scrolls away from the end.

fields.name: onEdit
fields.doc: Applied edit notifications for a caller-owned EditorKit document.

fields.name: document
fields.doc: Optional mutable EditorKit model shared with the persistent editor state.

fields.name: onCaretRect
fields.doc: Current logical-screen caret bounds after layout, or null when clipped out.

fields.name: onLayoutResolved
fields.doc: Borrowed retained text geometry after layout, for aligned companion views.

fields.name: semanticRole
fields.doc: Semantic role override used by composite editable controls.

fields.name: semanticActions
fields.doc: Semantic action capabilities override used by composite editable controls.

fields.name: tabWidth
fields.doc: Tab stops in space advances; zero preserves the default layout behavior.

fields.name: wrap
fields.doc: Explicit wrapping policy; null retains the normal single/multiline defaults.

fields.name: codeWordBoundaries
fields.doc: Use lexical identifier boundaries for code selection and word commands.

fields.name: withDocument
fields.doc: Creates a field backed by a shared document and edit transaction stream.

types.name: TextInputWindow
types.doc: A bounded UTF-8 window with absolute document code-point offsets.

types.name: TextNavigationIntent
types.doc: Keyboard navigation delegated by a controlled editor with multiple selections.

types.name: TextOffsetMap
types.doc: Compatibility entry point for the editor's local Unicode offset map.

types.name: TextRange
types.doc: Compatibility name for the editor core type.

types.name: TextSelection
types.doc: Anchored selection in absolute document codepoints, retaining direction and caret affinity.

types.name: Utf16Offset
types.doc: Compatibility name for the editor core type.

types.name: Utf8Offset
types.doc: Compatibility name for the editor core type.

types.name: Utf8Text
types.doc: UTF-8 helpers using the code-point offsets used by NativeKit text APIs.
